title: GROWTH evaluates exponential QR regression via stored x87 PC64 exp products and flushes subnormal forecasts to zero
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20228 and 20527, GROWTH(known_y's, [known_x's], [new_x's], [const]) fits excel_log(y) through the LINEST stored-PC64 x87 Householder QR pipeline (#NUM! if any y <= 0), evaluates exp(intercept) * prod(exp(b_j * x_j)) with each exp and multiply stored through x87 PC64, and flushes subnormal forecasts to 0 (unlike LOGEST, which preserves subnormal entries in its coefficient row). Matches 1,260/1,260 full-bank and 126/126 pinned GROWTH rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20228 (1,260/1,260 full-bank and 126/126 pinned GROWTH rows in witnesses/GROWTH.json) and Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dcj9k_regression (rows 510-655) and prefix_metadata (row 104).
